title: At the Kings' Gate
journal: I carry all three seal-stones of the kings' gate. I'm to bring them to Never-Writes-Twice, who stands at the back of Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the three seal-stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom. (marker: Never-Writes-Twice)

plan.going: I have all three stones the ghost at Teku-Sul named; the order wants them
plan.next: report to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom
plan.ways: none; the report is the step

answers: I carry the three seal-stones (Blackrose, Gemin, Vorannuhl) of the kings' gate. I must get them to Never-Writes-Twice before anyone reaches the gate at drowned Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth. Rival is the Collector, Ennodius Vanin.
Bring the three seal-stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom.
I can talk to Never-Writes-Twice and hand over the stones; I do not yet see another choice.
I do not understand why the Unbound seal trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar or where its key is, or how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound. I could ask Never-Writes-Twice.

title: At the Kings' Gate
journal: Never-Writes-Twice made me a Ka-Deelith, a War-Teacher of the Toh-Reel-Ka, and gave me the order's pike. Her watchers have not seen the Unbound near Teku-Sul, so I am ahead of them. I'm to dive to Teku-Sul Spire, open the Kings' Gate with the three stones and use the Eye where it sits to heal the trees. Then I'm to bring the stones back to her and hunt down Cuts-the-Old-Knot.
objectives: Dive to Teku-Sul Spire and go to the Kings' Gate. (marker: The Kings' Gate)

plan.going: I am a Ka-Deelith now. The order thinks I am ahead of the Unbound and has sent me to open the gate and heal the trees with the Eye; afterwards the stones go back to Never-Writes-Twice and I hunt Cuts-the-Old-Knot
plan.next: dive to Teku-Sul and go to the Kings' Gate
plan.ways: carry waterbreathing for the dive; in the east halls Unbound I was not warned of wait for me: fight them, slip past or hold them off with magic

answers: Never-Writes-Twice made me a Ka-Deelith of the Toh-Reel-Ka and gave me the pike and gauntlets/boots. The Unbound are not yet near Teku-Sul, so I am ahead of them. Healing the trees with the Eye matters for the marsh.
Dive to Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth and go to the Kings' Gate, set the three stones, use the Eye where it sits (not lift it).
Go straight there; afterwards take stones back to her and hunt Cuts-the-Old-Knot. I can also ask more topics first.
I do not fully understand why the Unbound seal trees or what the Fort Chalkmoth cellar holds; I could ask Never-Writes-Twice.
